request_binding.change: Project OS FIX for JobBot CHG-166-r5
request_binding.scope: Carry forward only the missing CHG-166 .25 receiver-lifecycle semantics onto the exact integrated main base while preserving all later integrated behavior.
constraints: Do not merge or move main.
Do not replace current-main runtime files wholesale with historical files.
Keep SQLite authoritative and application execution human-only.
Do not add challenge bypass, stealth, credential handling, cookie export, chrome.scripting injection, or focus theft.
Do not read or mutate production data/jobs.sqlite3.
Live LinkedIn, Indeed, and Glassdoor validation remains NOT_RUN in this FIX.

semantic_reconciliation.feature: Declarative document_start receiver bootstrap on LinkedIn, Indeed, and Glassdoor, alongside existing document_idle platform scripts
semantic_reconciliation.result: The bootstrap is declared for all three primary platforms and does not perform card/detail persistence or business actions.

semantic_reconciliation.feature: Early receiver attachment observability while navigation is in progress and the platform receiver has not loaded
semantic_reconciliation.result: The bootstrap reports its attachment and can answer readiness/lifecycle probes before DOM readiness; the worker records accepted attachment evidence.

semantic_reconciliation.feature: Inspection deferred until the platform receiver and relevant DOM are ready
semantic_reconciliation.result: Pre-ready business inspection returns inspect_deferred. Readiness requires the platform receiver signal and a non-loading document.

semantic_reconciliation.feature: Receiver attachment, frame, document ID, document generation, and attachment sequence observability
semantic_reconciliation.result: Lifecycle diagnostics and recovery validation distinguish stale attachment evidence from a new document/generation and record successful inspection evidence.

semantic_reconciliation.feature: Pending-navigation, requested URL, platform, origin, and search-context validation
semantic_reconciliation.result: Recovery validates the effective pending target URL and exact owned tab/window/platform/search context before and throughout transitions, then revalidates the settled target.

semantic_reconciliation.feature: One bounded same-target reload for receiver loss
semantic_reconciliation.result: Current main already had a bounded same-target reload; it remains in place and now must pass fresh attachment, document-generation, and context validation before resuming.

semantic_reconciliation.feature: Post-reload bounded readiness polling with generation checks
semantic_reconciliation.result: A bounded backoff wait accepts only fresh attachment evidence from the expected platform and a new document generation.

semantic_reconciliation.feature: At most one-for-one owned target regeneration after bounded receiver loss
semantic_reconciliation.result: One replacement attempt is allowed after same-target recovery; the replacement is validated before retiring the old owned target. No standalone detail tab is created.

semantic_reconciliation.feature: No accumulated windows/tabs, no focus theft, and preservation of existing search-tab ownership
semantic_reconciliation.result: Current owned-target lifecycle and inactive-tab behavior remain authoritative; receiver recovery stays within those ownership rules.

semantic_reconciliation.feature: Resume only the same durable checkpoint after validating the new receiver/document generation
semantic_reconciliation.result: The current task checkpoint is preserved across reload/regeneration and is not resumed against a stale document, wrong origin, or wrong search context.

semantic_reconciliation.feature: Exactly-once card/detail persistence through SQLite identity and existing card-before-pane checkpoint semantics
semantic_reconciliation.result: Current SQLite authority, source identity deduplication, and card-before-pane ordering remain intact and are exercised through recovery and regeneration.

semantic_reconciliation.feature: Receiver exhaustion remains incomplete/system-retryable while human site states remain fail-closed
semantic_reconciliation.result: Persistent receiver absence preserves the checkpoint and reports retryable/incomplete or unverified system state; challenge and sign-in states route to current human gates, while error/loading states do not become successful inspection.

semantic_reconciliation.feature: A receiver recovery or human gate on one platform does not stop healthy platform workers
semantic_reconciliation.result: Platform workers remain independently supervised; the new LinkedIn recovery/challenge fixture confirms Indeed completes without target or focus leakage.

semantic_reconciliation.feature: Declarative content-script delivery without programmatic injection
semantic_reconciliation.result: The extension continues to use manifest content scripts; repository checks assert chrome.scripting and executeScript are absent.
